props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state of the select when it is initially rendered.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the select when initially rendered.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with Select

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled value of the Select. Can be bound as `v-model`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the select for form submission.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the Select. Can be bound as `v-model:open`.
